initial_application: Historical commit 900d86347ce2213b5a037582aaceb378daebc258 explicitly addressed GF#12474 by strengthening warning/error severities in the old in-repository Java publisher validators/ProfileComparer classes and temporarily moving many resources in source/fhir.ini to FMM 0 until the stronger warnings could be handled.
additional_context: The old Java publisher sources touched by the 2016 application are no longer part of the current core checkout. Commit 9f549566d1346cad7db6d2afca6080d7cebdfbbe switched the build to Gradle with an external org.hl7.fhir:kindling dependency, and current build.gradle.kts still launches org.hl7.fhir.tools.publisher.Publisher from that dependency. Current suppressed-messages.txt preserves warning/information classifications for representative affected checks, while current source/fhir.ini contains contemporary FMM values rather than the temporary 2016 FMM-0 downgrade.
reconciliation: Created an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No core source edit is needed because the Jira-tagged application already happened, the active publisher implementation is external to this checkout, and current core inputs do not show a missing severity-policy change.
